Property.name: SvnUserName
Property.Description: The username of this source control user.

Method.name: GetStatus
Method.Description: Values in Global - ItfSourceCtrl 0 - The date and time when the corresponding external file was last modified 1 - The date and time when this Caché document was last modified 2 - The name of the user who has this Caché document checked out, if any

Method.name: OnBeforeLoad
OnAfterSave
Method.Implementation:
Write !, "Start OnAfterSave"
Set filename=..ExternalName(InternalName) #; File not mapped so nothing to do If filename="" Quit $$$OK Set name=$Piece(InternalName,".",1,$Length(InternalName,".")-1) #; CSP files are already files so not additional work needed If name["/" Quit $$$OK Set ext=$ZConvert($Piece(InternalName,".",$Length(InternalName,".")),"U") #; Do not export the default projects If ext="PRJ",$zconvert($extract(name,1,$length("default_")),"l")="default_" Quit $$$OK #; By convention items starting with Z,z,%z,%Z are not exported If ext'="PRJ",$extract($translate(name,"Z%","z"))'="z",'##class(%File).Exists(filename) Write !,"File ",filename," not found, skipping export" Quit $$$OK #; If time already matches nothing to do If ##class(%RoutineMgr).TS(InternalName)=$get(^ItfSourceCtrl(0,"ItemTimeStamp",InternalName)) Quit $$$OK
Do ##class(%File).CreateDirectoryChain(##class(%File).GetDirectory(filename)) Set sc=$$Export^%occXMLExport(filename,"-d /diffexport",InternalName) If $$$ISOK(sc) { Write !,"Exported '",InternalName,"' to file '",filename,"'" Set ^ItfSourceCtrl(0,"FileTimeStamp",InternalName)=##class(%File).GetFileDateModified(filename) Set ^ItfSourceCtrl(0,"ItemTimeStamp",InternalName)=##class(%RoutineMgr).TS(InternalName) } Else { Do DecomposeStatus^%apiOBJ(sc,,"d") Quit sc }
Write !, "Done OnAfterSave" Quit $$$OK

Method.name: OnAfterCompile
CheckIn
CheckOut
Method.Implementation:
set tStatus = $$$OK Set ..SvnUserName = "lpjnaras"
Set file=..ExternalName(InternalName) If file="" Quit $$$OK write !, "CheckOut file: " _ file
write !, "CheckOut: " _ file
Set cmd= "svn --username " _ ..SvnUserName _ " export " _ file
Set status = $ZF(-1, cmd)
write !, "Svn export " _ cmd _ " : " _ status If ##class(%File).Exists(file) { Quit $$$ERROR($$$GeneralError, "Failure: '"_InternalName_"' not checkedout, file: " _ file) } #; make sure we have latest version Set sc=..OnBeforeLoad(InternalName) If $$$ISERR(sc) Quit sc
//... Quit sc

Method.name: UndoCheckout
Method.Implementation:
set tStatus = $$$OK Write !, "Undo checkout" set username = "lpjnaras" Set file=..ExternalName(InternalName) If file="" Quit $$$OK
write !, "Check for: " _ file
If ##class(%File).Exists(file) { Write !, "Deleted file" Do ##class(%File).Delete(file) } Set cmd= "svn --username " _ username _ " update " _ file
Set status = $ZF(-1, cmd)
write !, "Get file from Svn update " _ cmd _ " : " _ status if status = 0 { #; Call the function to do the load Set sc=$system.OBJ.Load(file,"-l-d") If $$$ISOK(sc) { Write !,"Imported using Load command: '",InternalName,"' from file '",file,"'" Set ^ItfSourceCtrl(0,InternalName)=##class(%File).GetFileDateModified(file) Set ^ItfSourceCtrl(1,InternalName)=##class(%RoutineMgr).TS(InternalName) } Else { Do $SYSTEM.Status.DecomposeStatus(sc,.errors,"d") } } QUIT $$$OK

Method.name: IsInSourceControl
Method.Implementation: Write !, "IsInSourceControl" Set IsInSourceControl = 0 Do ..GetStatus(InternalName,.IsInSourceControl) Write !, "IsInSourceControl: " _ IsInSourceControl Quit IsInSourceControl

Method.name: AddToSourceControl
Method.Description: Called to add this item to source control
Method.Implementation:
write !, "Add to File Src Ctrl: " _ InternalName
Set file=..ExternalName(InternalName) Set namespace=$zu(5),timeout=2 Set ..SvnUserName = "lpjnaras"
write !, "By " _ ..SvnUserName ,!, " file: " _ file _ " in Name space: " _ namespace
Set sc = $System.OBJ.Export(InternalName, file)
write !, " Add to SourceControl: " _ file _ " export: " _ sc
SET status = ..AddToSvn(file)
if status = 0 { write !, "File is in SourceControl" Set IsInSourceControl=1 }
Quit $$$OK

Method.name: setSources
ReadCommentFile
Method.Implementation:
set CommentStr = "" Set InFile="C:\EnsembleSC\svnComment.txt" Close InFile Open InFile:"R":1 If '$Test Write !,InFile," cannot be opened." Quit 0
do ##class(%SYSTEM.Process).SetZEOF(1)
Use InFile ;sets InFile as the current device
Do { Read InRecord ;read record from file SET CommentStr = CommentStr _ ";" _ InRecord } While $ZEOF '= -1
Close InFile
Quit 0
